name: ARTOTEL Thamrin Jakarta
detail: Next to the Salina Department Store, you can reach Grand Indonesia and Plaza Indonesia malls in about a 10-minute walk. The Japanese Embassy is also nearby. The breakfast is delicious. The room is compact but very functional. It's sufficient for solo travelers. There are also larger rooms available, making it recommended for couples and friends as well. It's a cool hotel filled with art.

name: Townhouse Oak Ancol
detail: Recommendation for an affordable hotel in Jakarta with a strategic location in the city, suitable for a staycation with a partner or family. The service from all staff is good and friendly. The female receptionist and hotel supervisor are responsible for guests' complaints. Cleanliness is always maintained. I hope they continue to provide good service and response to guests' complaints.

name: Super OYO Townhouse OAK Hotel Fiducia Pondok Gede
detail: The stay experience was very satisfying. The price is comparable to the quality provided, the location is convenient, and the cleanliness of the property is well maintained. The staff is also friendly and helpful, while the available facilities support comfort during the stay. Overall, this property is worth considering for a practical and enjoyable stay experience.

name: Dafam Express Jaksa Jakarta
detail: We arrived at Dafam Express Jaksa on Friday, August 7, 2026, around 9:30 AM from Mount Bromo, Malang. I didn't expect much; all I wanted was for my husband to be able to change clothes and go to Friday prayers, and to be able to rest because he was still tired. Thank God all the hotel staff served us kindly even though we couldn't check in yet. Fortunately, we were able to enter the room 1 hour earlier. We didn't need to worry about finding dinner and lunch, as there are many options around the hotel. There are also several choices of mini markets. From the hotel, it's just a short walk to Sarinah. We even managed to take a morning walk to the HI Roundabout. Breakfast offered a lot of choices. I really liked it because all the dishes were delicious. Our vacation trip this time was extraordinarily exciting. Thank you, Dafam Express Jaksa Hotel Management. Unforgettable place 👍🙏👫

name: Discovery SCBD
detail: Upon Checked In Roelan and his team make sure my stay was splendid. The Concierge team and Virgo make sure all my deliveries are safely handed to me. The house keeping team are superb with making sure my room's comfortable and clean. Highly recomend Discovery SCBD

name: Wonderloft Hostel Kota Tua
detail: This is a wonderful hostel located in Jakarta's Old Town (Jakarta Kota Tua) in Indonesia. You can meet travelers visiting Indonesia from various countries, and there are plenty of sights, delicious food, and activities nearby. It is conveniently situated within walking distance to Chinatown. The famous Cafe Batavia in Jakarta Old Town is also very close, and right across from it are the Indonesia Financial Museum and Mandiri Bank Financial Museum, making it easy to access the Trans Jakarta Bus line No. 1 heading towards Jakarta city. Additionally, Stasiun Jakarta Kota, the Jakarta city rail station, is right in front, which serves Indonesia’s national railway and urban subway. During my week-long stay here, what I appreciated most was the friendliness of the staff working at the hostel. Their kindness went beyond simply smiling and greeting; they actively tried to help with anything needed and made a strong effort to meet the travelers' needs, which I am very grateful for and highly commend. In the communal area on the first floor of the accommodation, you can easily cook with simple food or ingredients, and the hostel also offers a variety of Indonesian and foreign dishes at good prices, which is great to take advantage of. I had breakfast a few times during my stay, and I found it delightful that they provided delicious food at affordable prices. While Jakarta is honestly not the easiest city for travel, there are still some attractions worth visiting, and this accommodation provides detailed guidance on those. Therefore, if you are visiting Jakarta for the first time, I would recommend this place. I stayed in a relatively small cabin, but the bed was comfortable, allowing me to sleep well, and I made good use of the pillow and towel. Additionally, there is a separate locker inside the cabin where I could safely store my personal bag using the locker key received at check-in, and there is also a large communal locker for bigger suitcases or larger luggage, which is another strong point of this accommodation. Now, let me share briefly some points that I found disappointing during my stay. First, there were many mosquitoes in the common area of the accommodation. I was a bit disappointed that I struggled with mosquitoes throughout my stay. It is true that mosquitoes are prevalent throughout Jakarta, so I can't entirely blame the hostel for this, but it was the most uncomfortable aspect for me. Second, the cabin I stayed in had no windows, so ventilation was poor. Consequently, I couldn’t avoid the musty smell from the air conditioning, which was also disappointing. Third, while the internet speed in the communal area was decent and relatively convenient, using the internet in the rooms was almost impossible. The issue seemed to be both speed and the fact that there were too many users for the facilities installed, making it difficult to handle the demand. However, it did connect well during the early morning hours. Lastly, the number of bathrooms and showers seemed a bit insufficient considering the number of guests. The restrooms are separated for men and women, but as there are primarily male guests, one might have to wait a long time to shower in the morning and evening. The staff cleans daily, and while they do a good job, the older building sometimes has drainage issues, and there were places in the shower without hooks to hang clothes, which I think needs improvement. Nonetheless, if I have another opportunity to visit Jakarta, I would like to use this hostel again. Almost all the staff who greeted and helped me with a smile every time I encountered them were wonderful. I want to express my gratitude to them.

name: Classic Hotel
detail: It's a slightly old hotel, but it is clean. It's a sufficiently comfortable place to stay. The staff is also kind. I wish there were a few more accessible restaurants for travelers nearby. The access is not bad. The train station is close, but it's far to get to the bus (TransJakarta).

name: The Orient Jakarta, a Royal Hideaway Hotel
detail: The bed is very comfortable, and the soft mattress has excellent support. The hotel's facilities are very unique, with different patterns on every door, making you feel like you are in a piece of art. The outdoor pool on the fifth floor is perfect, with a swimming pool and a small hot tub, where you can soak in and enjoy the beautiful views of Jakarta when night falls. The facilities are very new, highly recommend staying here!

name: Ashley Wahid Hasyim Jakarta
detail: The hotel is clean, the rooms are large and comfortable, the corridors between the rooms are clean and pleasant. The main highlight is the self-service free laundry facility that sets it apart from other hotels. This is very helpful for travelers. The food is delicious, and the location is strategic, close to dining places and more. Definitely recommended!

name: AYANA Midplaza Jakarta
detail: I have been to many hotels on my business trips to Jakarta, and this one is currently my number one choice among the hotels I have visited. Cons: Noise. Almost all hotels in Jakarta are similar in this regard. The noise from vehicles on the road can be so disruptive that it affects sleep, but this hotel provides earplugs, which shows they are considerate. Pros: Overall, the hotel is clean and the staff is friendly. The bedding seems to be the best, especially since they offer various types of pillows. Additionally, the surrounding shopping malls and transportation options are excellent. The facilities, including a swimming pool, sauna, café, and restaurant, are all more than adequate.
